w10_T4_000002: A school library received 51 boxes of donated books, and every box held exactly 3 books. The librarian sent 137 of these donated books across town to a partner school that had lost its collection in a flood. She then found that 3 more of them had water damage on the spine and set those aside for recycling. A week later a parent walked in with 12 further books for the same donation shelf. The library's catalogue records the donation shelf as single volumes rather than as whole shelf-sets. How many donated books does the library have on that shelf now?
w10_T4_000004: Elena keeps a prepaid balance on the parking app she uses near her office, and on Monday morning it stood at 47 minutes. Before she left the house she topped the balance up by 56 minutes. Her meeting in the city ran long and the meter drew 76 minutes off the balance. In the afternoon a colleague transferred her 31 minutes from his own account, and the app's loyalty scheme credited her a further 51 minutes that evening. The app always shows a parking balance in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes are on Elena's parking balance at the end of the day?
w10_T4_000008: On Monday morning a fruit stall opened with 40 ripe mangoes on the counter, and a neighbouring grower brought over 14 more before the first customers arrived. During the afternoon the owner cut every mango on the counter into 8 slices for his tasting bowls. By early evening 402 of those slices had been sold to passers-by, and a late delivery from the packing shed added another 34 slices to the bowls. Overnight the supplier tripled the number of slices ready for the next morning's market. How many slices are ready for the morning market?
w10_T4_000022: A stationery shop counted 131 notebooks in its storeroom at the start of the month. 3 of them were ruined when a pipe leaked and were thrown away, then one delivery brought in 41 notebooks and a second delivery brought 76. The owner decided to send a shipment to each of the chain's 6 branches, and each shipment was to contain as many notebooks as the storeroom now held. The shop's delivery van makes 4 round trips a week. Stock is always recorded as single notebooks rather than as sealed cartons. How many notebooks were shipped to the branches altogether?
w10_T4_000024: A community theatre printed 183 programme booklets for the opening night of its new play. Every booklet contains 5 pages, and every page carries 6 photographs of the cast. Each photograph is built up from 6 separate layers of coloured ink. The printing machine lays down 5 ink layers on each pass of its roller. The theatre's hall seats 400 people. How many passes of the roller were needed to print the whole run of booklets?
w10_T4_000036: Priya's chicken coop began the week with 33 hens. She bought 8 more at the Saturday market, and a neighbour who was moving house gave her another 43. On Sunday every hen in the coop laid exactly 3 eggs. Priya packed all of those eggs into small cartons holding 3 eggs each, and every carton was filled completely. Her coop runs 12 metres along the back fence. How many cartons did Priya fill?
w10_T4_000037: A school's recycling bin held 114 plastic bottles when the caretaker checked it on Monday. Students dropped in 48 bottles on Tuesday and 27 on Wednesday. On Thursday the caretaker took 71 bottles away to the crusher, and on Friday another 22 were added. The remaining bottles were then shared out equally among the 5 art classes for a sculpture project, and each class turned every bottle it received into 7 small ornaments. The caretaker records the bin's contents as individual bottles rather than as full crates. How many ornaments did one art class make?
w10_T4_000042: Marcus opened the growing season with 79 seedlings in his nursery. A supplier delivered 60 more in the first week, and his business partner Elena arrived with 72 seedlings of her own, which was more than the supplier had brought. Every seedling in the nursery was then used to grow 9 cuttings. A neighbouring farm donated 28 extra cuttings to the same bench, and later the nursery sold 567 cuttings to a garden centre. The potting shed can hold 15 trays at a time. How many cuttings are left at the nursery?
w10_T4_000044: Greenfield School received 33 boxes of chalk for the new term, with 5 sticks in every box. The art teacher added 41 loose sticks to the same cupboard, the music room contributed 77, and a parent donated 6 more. A second school across town, Riverton, stocked its own cupboard with exactly the same number of chalk sticks as Greenfield now had. The district office is 9 kilometres from Greenfield's gate. How many chalk sticks do the two cupboards hold altogether?
w10_T4_000047: A bottling plant filled 211 crates of mineral water on one of its production lines on Monday. Each crate holds 6 boxes, and each box holds 4 bottles. Quality control found 3044 bottles with faulty seals and pulled every one of them off the line. Each bottle that remained was then decorated with 9 promotional stickers, and a leftover sheet from the previous week supplied a further 60 stickers to the same line's total. Everything described so far happened on just one line, and the plant's other lines matched it exactly, for 3 identical lines in all. How many promotional stickers did the plant use that Monday?
w10_T4_000051: A food truck rolled up to the office park with 108 sandwiches in its chiller. During the morning rush it sold 41 of them, and at noon a health inspector removed 22 that had been left too long on the warm counter. In the afternoon the central kitchen delivered 79 freshly made sandwiches to the hatch, and in the early evening a second batch of 30 arrived by scooter. The truck's generator runs for 6 hours on a full tank. The tally sheet counts sandwiches one by one rather than by the tray. How many sandwiches does the truck have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000058: A pottery studio loaded 109 trays of tiles into the kiln, with 8 tiles resting on every tray. When the kiln was opened, 213 tiles had cracked in the heat and were thrown into the scrap bin. An apprentice fetched 21 sound tiles left over from an earlier firing, and a supplier delivered 30 more that afternoon. Every tile that was fit to use then received 5 coats of glaze. The studio keeps a dozen spare kiln shelves stacked in the back room. How many coats of glaze were painted in the studio that day?
w10_T4_000066: A recycling depot took in 75 sacks of aluminium cans on Friday and another 68 sacks on Saturday. Every sack holds 9 bundles, and every bundle holds 9 cans. A primary school then dropped off 50 loose cans at the gate. The depot shipped 8818 cans to the smelter on Monday and a further 812 to a second buyer on Tuesday. The depot's ledger is kept in individual cans rather than in whole sacks. How many cans are still sitting at the depot?
w10_T4_000067: A scout troop was given 192 embroidered badges by a retiring scoutmaster. The badges were divided equally among the troop's 6 patrols, and each patrol then divided its share equally among its 4 scouts. One scout, Nadia, already had 67 badges of her own at home, and she added the badges she had just been given to that collection. She sewed 34 of them onto a display banner for the hall and posted 4 to her cousin in another town. The troop hall has a dozen wooden benches along its walls. How many badges are left loose in Nadia's box?
w10_T4_000070: Early on Saturday morning a market stall set out 44 jars of honey. The stallholder found 6 jars with cracked lids and took them off the table, and then a van from the apiary brought her 25 more. Through the late morning 40 jars were sold to shoppers, and at lunchtime a café owner bought 11 for his kitchen. In the afternoon she emptied every jar still on the table into 7 small sample cups each, and in the evening she added 25 sample cups she had filled the night before. The stall's price board lists everything in cents rather than in dollars. How many sample cups does she have by the end of the evening?
w10_T4_000073: Owen's bicycle workshop had 135 spokes in the parts drawer on Monday morning. He used 91 of them rebuilding wheels for a cycling club. His business partner Priya added 12 spokes from her own toolkit, which was fewer than Owen had just used. They then discovered that 28 of the spokes in the drawer were bent and threw those out. Every spoke left in the drawer was cut into 3 short lengths for a metal sculpture, and Priya brought over 43 lengths she had already cut at home. How many short lengths are in the sculpture pile?
w10_T4_000074: A hardware warehouse stores its stock of screws on 73 pallets. Each pallet carries 8 cartons, each carton holds 6 boxes, and each box contains 9 screws. Ahead of a large construction contract the owner tripled the number of screws held in the warehouse. A final delivery van then dropped off another 48 screws at the loading bay. How many screws are in the warehouse now?
w10_T4_000075: A dance school had 165 costumes hanging in its storage room. A troupe that was closing down donated 76 more. The wardrobe manager found that 125 of the costumes were too moth-eaten to use and sent those to the tip, and a further 77 had been lent to a partner school years ago and were never returned. Every costume still on the rails was photographed from 9 angles for the online hire catalogue. The rehearsal hall has a dozen tall windows along one side. How many photographs went into the catalogue?
w10_T4_000081: Hassan and Mei share a candle stall at the Friday night market. Hassan set out with 136 candles from his own workshop, and Mei brought 60, a smaller batch than Hassan's. Before the gates opened they tripled their combined stock with a rush order from the workshop down the road. They then packed all the candles equally into 6 crates for the stall. Every candle in one crate was finished with 8 lengths of ribbon. The market runs for 4 hours each Friday. How many lengths of ribbon were tied onto the candles in that one crate?
w10_T4_000084: A vineyard was planted with 154 rows of vines, and there were 9 vines in every row. A late frost killed 1161 of the vines outright. The owner then pulled out another 200 vines that had shown signs of disease. Each vine that survived was trained onto 4 support wires along the trellis. The vineyard's records count individual vines rather than whole rows. How many support wires were used on the surviving vines?
w10_T4_000085: Early on Saturday morning Daniel loaded 47 boxes of apples onto his roadside truck, and each box held 8 apples. By midday 258 apples had been sold to passing drivers. In the afternoon his sister Rosa took over and sliced every apple still on the truck into 7 pieces, which was more pieces per apple than Daniel had managed the previous week. In the early evening she dried each piece into 6 thin chips in the trailer's oven. Just before closing a neighbour arrived with 52 ready-made chips to add to the batch. How many chips did the pair have at the end of the day?
w10_T4_000087: At dawn a fishing crew hauled in 71 nets, and each net held 5 fish. During the morning the cook kept 40 fish for the crew's own kitchen, and 270 were sold at the harbour market. In the afternoon every fish still on deck was filleted into 8 strips. In the evening the smokehouse tripled the number of strips by slicing them thinner before hanging them, and a late buyer added 57 strips of his own to the same batch. The boat's engine is 12 years old and due for a rebuild. How many strips went into the smokehouse batch?
w10_T4_000091: On Saturday morning a gardener picked 66 tomatoes from her greenhouse and packed them equally into 6 baskets. At noon she carried one basket into the kitchen and used 8 of the tomatoes from it to make a pot of sauce. In the afternoon she cut every tomato still in that basket into 5 wedges for a party platter. In the evening she pinned each wedge with 3 cocktail sticks so it would hold together. How many cocktail sticks did she use on the platter?
w10_T4_000093: Nina and Omar run an invitation-printing stall at a craft fair. Nina fed 96 sheets of card through the press, and each sheet produced 6 invitations. A smudged stamp spoiled 198 of the invitations and they were binned. Omar then stuck 3 stickers onto every good invitation, more stickers per card than Nina had used at last year's fair. Overnight the damp air loosened 525 stickers and they fell off. The stall's stock list counts single stickers rather than full sheets. How many stickers are still attached to the invitations?
w10_T4_000094: Amara baked 156 biscuits for a family gathering and packed them equally into 6 tins. She opened one tin and split the biscuits in it equally between herself and her brother Felix, who ended up with exactly as many as she did. Felix ate 7 of his biscuits straight away, and then their grandmother handed him 54 more from her own kitchen. He decided to press 6 chocolate chips into each of the biscuits he was holding, and every chip was made from 9 tiny cocoa flakes. The recipe card in the family folder lists weights in grams rather than kilograms. How many cocoa flakes were used on Felix's biscuits?
